legend: Single large cell with a high N:C ratio and an irregular nucleus with two nucleoli, in a background of lymphocytes (imprint of a lymph node, Giemsa).
Seminoma as dispersed single cells in a tigroid background with lymphocytes (imprint of a lymph node, Giemsa).
Metastasis to the lung showing a tissue fragment demonstrating crowding, and cells with finely foamy to granular cytoplasm and prominent nuclear pleomorphism in a bloody background (Giemsa).

Metastasis to the lung showing dispersed single cells with marked nuclear pleomorphism, prominent macronucleoli, and moderate cytoplasm containing small, discrete cytoplasmic vacuoles, in a background of metachromatic material and blood (Giemsa).
Metastasis to the lung showing a tissue fragment of tumour cells with cytoplasmic clearing, prominent sieve-like spaces, and rare hyaline globules (cell block, H&E).

Intraoperative touch preparation from metastasis to the pleural cavity and mediastinum, showing sheets of crowded undifferentiated cells with a high N:C ratio and irregular nuclei with granular chromatin, and some apoptosis (touch preparation, Giemsa).

Crowded tissue fragment consisting of tumour cells with enlarged pleomorphic nuclei and pale, glassy cytoplasm with variably defined cell borders. Mitoses are present. Final diagnosis on excision was mixed germ cell tumour with yolk sac tumour and mature teratoma (Pap).
Same patient as in Fig. <<28148>>. A crowded tissue fragment of tumour cells with pleomorphic nuclei and a variable amount of finely vacuolated cytoplasm (Giemsa).
Tissue fragments of ciliated columnar bronchial epithelium associated with many inflammatory cells, histiocytes, and occasional keratinized squamous epithelial cells (Pap).
Squamous cell carcinoma present in a teratoma. Tissue fragments and single cells are keratinized, with variably sized hyperchromatic or pyknotic nuclei in a background of cellular debris (Pap).

Small blue round cells suspended in a chondromyxoid and fibrillary background, corresponding to the immature teratoma in small biopsy fragments within the cell block. Other areas showed basaloid cells and crush artefact corresponding to the embryonal carcinoma (touch preparation, Giemsa).
